title: Choose Parity's visual world
question: Re-rolled with your steer: a concept visual first, with a short statement of the problem. The roll assigned Two Beams, One Stage.

options.label: Two Beams, One Stage
options.lineage: Theatre lighting: follow spots cutting haze on a black stage
options.thesis: Two spotlights aimed at the same mark; one falls short, and the shortfall is the pay gap.
materials: spike-tape marks on a black stage floor
options.viewport: An edge-to-edge dark stage where two beams reach for the same taped mark and one stops 9.1% short; beside it, three lines state the problem, then Start a report.
options.risk: Light drawn as gradients can look like generic glow; it has to behave like real theatre light, with haze, falloff and hard gate edges.

raised.raise: Figures are set along the beams themselves, and the centre of the stage is left unlit.
Measurements are marked on the stage floor like chalk ticks, in tabular numerals.
Each published report owns one stage colour, carried through every page of it.
The stage fills the whole first viewport, edge to edge; nothing sits on a plain background.
The stage floor carries one ten-division scale that every figure is measured against.
How many employees have checked their record shows as quiet live presence, never as names.

options.label: Payslip Under Ultraviolet
options.lineage: Security printing: guilloché, microtext and UV-reactive ink
options.thesis: Under the right light the payslip shows it is genuine, and still hides what you earn.
options.viewport: A payslip lit by black light fills the first view; its salary line stays dark while a guilloché seal fluoresces Proven, beside three lines stating the problem.
options.risk: Violet glow on near-black is close to the familiar crypto look; the guilloché must be precise security engraving, not decoration.

options.label: Signal Bench Oscilloscope
options.thesis: Two channels overlaid on one graticule, the gap measured with cursors.
options.viewport: A phosphor trace on an etched grid.
options.case: Clear for engineers, but green phosphor is the neon-on-black default and cold for a people topic.
options.kept: One ten-division scale that every figure is measured against.

options.label: Accretion Disk Threshold
options.viewport: A glowing disk bending around a black centre.
options.case: Spectacular, but says nothing about pay or proof.
options.kept: Figures set along the light itself, the centre left unlit.

options.label: Forge and Power Hammer
options.thesis: Each blow visibly lengthens the bar.
options.case: Violent energy clashes with an equality topic.
options.kept: Measurements ruled like chalk marks, in tabular numerals.

options.label: Yé-yé Pop Sleeve
options.thesis: One flat saturated ground per release.
options.viewport: A tangerine sleeve with a cropped portrait.
options.case: Bright and light, against the dark cinematic brief.
options.kept: Each report owns one colour, carried through all its pages.

options.label: Lowbrow Gallery Panel
options.case: Chaotic and unserious for a compliance proof.
options.kept: Total commitment: the first view is filled edge to edge.

options.label: ANSI Nightboard
options.thesis: A neighbourhood made of text at 2 a.m.
options.viewport: ANSI title art pouring in line by line.
options.case: Retro terminal chrome reads as a gag, not a proof.
options.kept: Presence is scarce and precious: live, anonymous check-ins.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark web3 product landing, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, two buttons and a large product screenshot on a glowing dark gradient.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every dark crypto landing page.
